items.title: Near Heights Community Planning Area Assessment
items.description: Documents Near Heights land use, transportation, housing, economic conditions, community facilities, public engagement, proposed projects, policy priorities, and performance metrics across the International District, Nob Hill, university area, and surrounding neighborhoods.
items.provenance_status: Official City PDF path, City-branded report, current City CPA page, and Internet Archive capture reconcile the recovered document; the original direct City PDF now returns HTTP 404
processing_notes: One-hundred-fifty-six-page City assessment prepared for the November 10, 2022 EPC hearing and accepted by City Council on April 3, 2023.
Recovered from the Internet Archive capture recorded in the Windows download metadata.
Original authoritative source preserved without modification.

items.title: 2015 Bikeways and Trails Facilities Plan - Final
items.description: Establishes Albuquerque's adopted 2015 bikeway and trail network, policies, design guidance, project priorities, implementation strategies, maintenance practices, and supporting technical material that preceded the current 2024 plan.
items.provenance_status: Official City lineage, former direct PDF path, May 2015 City-branded final report, and Internet Archive capture reconcile the recovered authoritative document
processing_notes: Three-hundred-twelve-page May 2015 final plan recovered from the Internet Archive capture recorded in the Windows download metadata.
The file is unusually large because it preserves the complete final plan with high-resolution maps, graphics, technical material, and appendices.
The existing 4,402,773-byte R2 object is not a smaller copy of this final: it is a distinct 131-page 2014 draft and will be retained and relabeled for historical comparison.

No smaller authoritative copy of the complete final was located. Optimization would modify the authoritative source, so the original is preserved without recompression, downsampling, conversion, or splitting.
